title: ai-badger model groups registry
description: Level (low|medium|high) to ordered OpenRouter model list. Canonical source is features/common/data/model-groups.json, delivered to .ai-badger/model-groups.json. Index 0 of each group is the preferred pin. Structural shape only: preferred-first, lexicographic price order (with the demoted-tail exemption), per-group id uniqueness, tail position and the weights-identity evidence rule are enforced by the model_groups validator, which draft 2020-12 cannot express.

measuredAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD pricing/evidence date for the whole file. Date-shaped values are enforced by the model_groups validator; a bare format keyword is advisory under this repo's validator.

source.description: Provenance pointer, e.g. the brief or memory context the seed was verified against.

id.description: Fully-qualified model id. Bare aliases never appear here.

evidence.description: One line saying why this member sits here. Entries sharing a weightsId state the relationship.

aliases.description: Always-latest pointers. Documentary; the resolver never follows them.

weightsId.description: Capability-identity key: entries sharing one are the same weights.

status.description: Demoted entries are display-only tail: skipped for price order, pinned last with revisionWatch.

revisionWatch.description: True flags an evidence-demoted entry needing revisit before any other refresh work.

measuredAt.description: Per-entry override; defaults to the top-level measuredAt.
